text: 凯撒旅业公告，控股股东青岛环海湾文化旅游发展集团有限公司拟自公告披露之日起2个月内，通过集中竞价交易增持公司股份，增持金额不低于人民币5000万元、不超过人民币6000万元，不设价格区间。资金来源为专项贷款与自有资金，其中专项贷款资金占比不超过90%，自有资金占比不低于10%。环海湾文旅已取得浦发银行青岛分行贷款承诺函，银行同意提供不超过5000万元的股票增持专项贷款，贷款期限不超过3年，具体以最终签署的借款合同为准。增持计划可能因资本市场变化或资金未能及时筹措等原因无法实施或无法全部实施；增持主体承诺在增持期间及计划完成后6个月内不减持公司股份。
text_en: Caissa Tosun announced that its controlling shareholder, Qingdao Huanhaiwan Cultural Tourism Development Group Co., Ltd., plans to increase its stake in the company through centralized bidding within 2 months from the date of the announcement, with the increase amount no less than RMB 50 million and no more than RMB 60 million, with no price range set. The funds will come from a special loan and its own funds, with the special loan accounting for no more than 90% and its own funds no less than 10%. Huanhaiwan Cultural Tourism has obtained a loan commitment letter from Shanghai Pudong Development Bank Qingdao Branch, under which the bank agreed to provide a special loan of no more than RMB 50 million for the share increase, with a term of no more than 3 years, subject to the final signed loan contract. The increase plan may fail to be implemented or fully implemented due to changes in the capital market or failure to raise funds in a timely manner; the increasing entity undertakes not to reduce its holdings of the company's shares during the increase period and within 6 months after the plan is completed.
